Wait top band rows3-5 corresponds to one row of blocks? Bottom band rows6-15 is 10 rows, maybe represents two rows of blocks? Let's check heights. Row2: [2,5,7]

Here only one horizontal boundary at row5/6. So 2 rows.

Thus output:
[[1,9,9],[2,5,7]]
